mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.8% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 3.8%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and retail sales indicate robust consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during expansionary demand cycles.
failure_condition: The joint rise of HOUST and RSAFS in the prior month does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production exceeding 0.5% over the prior month signals an economic slowdown that triggers monetary policy easing, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines by >0.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO declines by >0.5% during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 2.5% signals rising inflation that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment exceeding 0.5% over the prior month signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in year-over-year CPI and the federal funds rate indicate a monetary tightening cycle that compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise of CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS in the prior month does not produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales increase exceeding 510,000 million dollars signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS rises above 510,000 million dollars.
